timeline: Clara notices a sleeved fragment of charred paper from the fourth day's test has split its Mylar sleeve and is growing fine black threads that move independently.
Clara finds that the carefully preserved folder from the second day has become a dense root network, with black vascular growth connecting all sleeved pages and forming a pulp-like mass.
Clara examines a neglected unsaved scrap and observes it has only thin, desiccated black stain with no active growth.
Clara confirms that the black root distribution under the main corridor matches the branching pattern from the star chart C008, leading to a sealed hatch.
She breaks the living root lock with a crowbar, releasing black sap, and opens the hatch.
She descends a 20-step stairwell into warm, blood-temperature water to a lower cabinet.
She finds an intact central drawer with accession number C009 and opens it with lock picks.
Clara tears the accession ledger into two halves, halting the writhing black filaments.
She realizes the entire archive is a feeding structure: every preserved sheet is a synapse in a creature metabolizing memory.
She walks through the main corridor without stopping to examine the growths; preservation is the enemy.
She descends the same stairwell to the lower chamber; the water has risen to knee height and is warm as a fever.
She reaches the pressure-gate room: a circular chamber with six iron wheels arranged like a compass rose, each controlling a sluice valve into the peat channels.
Using the tallies from star chart C008, she turns the first wheel 47 rotations, the second 32, the third 61 (causing a shudder), and begins the fourth wheel.

open_threads: Why does preservation (sleeving, careful handling) correlate with active black growth?
What is the nature of the black vascular growth?
The original ink/handwriting seems to be absorbed – is the growth a form of contamination or a life form? (Now partially answered: it is a creature metabolizing memory)
The observatory is flooded and decaying – what caused it?
What is the significance of the 'sister-linked route' and the map under the floor? (Now known as the sluice route to the peat channels)
What does the drawer C009 contain, and how does it connect to the star chart C008?
What is the purpose of the lower cabinet and why was it preserved while the strongroom decayed?
What is the creature that metabolizes memory?
Will the sluice sequence succeed in draining or collapsing the bog?
Why is the water level rising and what does it signify?
facts_established: Black threads from charred paper can move and split protective Mylar sleeves.
The growth is denser and more active on sleeved/preserved pages than on neglected scraps.
The folder from the second day, carefully sleeved, became a solid root network with organic pulp.
Ash from the same paper remains inert, no growth.
Clara is a preservationist working in a flooded observatory.
The watch in Clara's pocket had wound itself to its limit – a possible subtle anomaly.
The black root distribution under the main corridor exactly matches the branching pattern from star chart C008.
The roots can form a living lock; breaking it releases black sap that dissolves in water.
There is a sealed hatch beneath the main corridor, leading down a 20-step stairwell.
The water in the stairwell is warm, like blood temperature.
At the bottom of the stairwell is a lower cabinet: a steel strongroom with ruined interior but a single intact central drawer.
The intact drawer is oiled mahogany with brass lock and bears accession number C009.
Clara opened the lock with lock picks.
Tearing the accession ledger halts the writhe of black filaments, stopping their attempts to reconnect.
The entire archive is a feeding structure; every preserved sheet is a synapse in a creature that metabolizes memory.
The star chart C008 contains sluice markers and pressure-gate tallies: rotation counts for six wheels (47, 32, 61, 18, 53, 27).
The pressure-gate room is a circular chamber with six iron wheels arranged like a compass rose, each controlling a sluice valve into peat channels.
Clara has turned the first three wheels: 47, 32, and 61 rotations, and has begun the fourth.
spice_progression: Clara destroys the catalogue and confronts the archive as a creature; the sluice route from the star chart leads her to the pressure-gate room, where she begins turning the wheels to release the bog.
